post-1788771685045-k789ro.title: Recycling guide for local bins
post-1788771685045-k789ro.content: A simple app that tells you what goes in each local bin based on your address. It updates automatically when rules change and avoids confusion about what can or can't be recycled.
post-1788771685045-k789ro.enrichmentPlan: First, research local recycling guidelines and create a database of items and their corresponding bins. Next, develop a simple app interface where users can input their address. Integrate an API to automatically update recycling rules based on location. Then, implement a search function for common items and a map feature for recycling centers. Test the app with a small group of users to gather feedback and make improvements. Finally, launch the app and promote it through local sustainability groups and social media. Continue to monitor and update the database to ensure accuracy and relevance over time.

post-1788748135221-wq9iwc.title: Branded auth emails for every app from one worker
post-1788748135221-wq9iwc.content: Supabase auth emails all look the same. One tiny worker with a themes table sends each app's confirm and reset emails in its own colours and voice through Resend. Add a row per app, never touch a template again.
post-1788748135221-wq9iwc.enrichmentPlan: First, set up a Supabase project with a themes table to store app-specific email settings. Next, create a worker that listens for auth events (signup, reset). When triggered, the worker fetches the app's theme from the database. Then, use Resend to generate and send personalized emails with dynamic content. Test with a few apps to ensure customization works. Finally, deploy the worker and document how to add new apps by inserting rows into the themes table. Ensure the system is secure and scalable for future expansion.

post-1772355716310-tkpd47.title: Browser history search with local embeddings
post-1772355716310-tkpd47.content: Full-text search across your entire browsing history. No cloud, instant results. Find that article from months ago.
post-1772355716310-tkpd47.enrichmentPlan: Start by building a browser extension to capture and store history data locally. Next, develop a model to generate embeddings for each page's content. Create a desktop app that indexes this data and provides a search interface. Implement semantic search using the embeddings for relevant results. Test performance and accuracy, then optimize for speed and memory usage. Finally, add cross-browser support and ensure data privacy through local storage only.
